command: Official Roblox Studio MCP: start_stop_play; execute_luau client sample using RunService.RenderStepped and Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb; stop without saving

parameters.scenario: World initialized; static local solo scene; no route interaction during sample

sourceIdentity.scope: Git-tracked and nonignored workspace files in their current working-tree contents, excluding evidence artifacts.

method: Collected 300 positive RenderStepped delta values below two seconds, sorted them, and reported mean/median/p95/maximum. Read Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, InstanceCount, SceneDrawcallCount, and SceneTriangleCount after sampling.
limitations: The sample report records a workspace digest, but a digest of the exact loaded place artifact and a contemporaneous sample log were not retained. Treat the measurement as an unverified development baseline, not source-bound acceptance or device certification.
A single high-end laptop Studio sample is not a representative mobile or standalone Roblox client profile; Studio overhead skews frame rate.
No sustained thermal test, touch/controller, two-client, network, cold-load, or hardware memory budget test was run.
The result proves instrumentation can be collected locally, not that the project meets a product/device budget.
